User.title: User Profile
User.description: Secure record of user profile, plan, settings, and daily interaction counts.

isAdmin.description: Indicates if the user has supervisor/admin status.

plan.description: The tier of consciousness plan unlocked.

registeredAt.description: ISO timestamp of user profile registration.

resonanceScore.description: Aggregated daily emotional alignment and bio-resonance score.

accessibilityMode.description: Enables enhanced visual contrast and auditory descriptions.

neuroMode.description: Adaptive experience mode for neurodivergent pathways.

dailyConversations.description: Number of successfully completed conversations today.

lastPlayedDate.description: Y-M-D string tracking the logic of daily reset counters.

ambientVolume.description: Preferred volume level for atmospheric patterns (0.0 to 1.0).

id.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry.

text.description: The self-reflective thoughts or notes typed by the user.

userId.description: UID of the owning authenticated user.

GardenPlant.title: Garden Plant
GardenPlant.description: A single botanical element representing the user's progress in Jardim Interior.

name.description: Custom user-given name to the plant.

color.description: Hex or Tailwind CSS color token.

SystemConfig.title: System Configuration
SystemConfig.description: Global settings such as Dr. Evaldo system prompts.

AdminLog.title: Admin Activity Log
AdminLog.description: Logs recording actions taken by administrators.

/users/{userId}.description: Primary user profile, settings, and stats database.

/users/{userId}/journals/{journalId}.description: Nested collection holding all private self-reflections.

/users/{userId}/plants/{plantId}.description: Nested collection of Jardim Interior botanical elements grown by the user.

/system_config/{configId}.description: Global administration parameters and system prompts.

/admin_logs/{logId}.description: Audit trail records for supervisors' modifications.
